source: lab (captured; background replaced by a synthetic colour gradient, 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static: phase-correlation shift of the three static objects vs the median background is < 0.3 px in every frame (scripts/camera_check.py)
camera.view: oblique top-down view of a flat surface (floor/table, replaced by gradient). Tops of cup and card are visible; image-up = farther from camera (blue object shrinks while moving up-left). No horizon, no ground texture, no shadows (background replaced), so no vanishing points measurable.

blue_object.description: blue box-shaped toy (likely a toy car) with yellow and white rectangular print; the only moving object
blue_object.direction: straight line up-left in the image, heading about -148 deg (atan2(dy,dx), y down), i.e. along its own long axis; nearly constant
blue_object.apparent_size: shrinks steadily: bbox 144x128 -> 109x88 px, mask area 11803 -> 6673 px (sqrt ratio 0.75); minAreaRect long side 134 -> 109 px, short side 102 -> 77 px. Early frames (0-10) are motion-blurred, which inflates length by several px
blue_object.pixel_step_per_frame: about 11-13 px/frame in frames 1-11, falling to about 5.5-7 px/frame by frames 33-47 (slowing in the image; partly because it moves away from the camera)

basketball.description: orange Wilson basketball, right of centre, near the blue object's start

cup.description: small white/silver tumbler (cup) with dark lid, standing upright, centre-left

white_card.description: white rectangular flat item (box/booklet/card with grey print) lying on the surface, bottom centre, rotated about 60 deg

events.event: blue_object already moving at first frame (no start of motion in clip)
blue_object passes the basketball without contact (closest mask gap ~28 px at frame 0, increasing)
irregular step (about 2x normal centroid step: 19.9 px vs ~10) - probable dropped/irregular capture frame
irregular step (13.4 px vs ~6) - probable dropped/irregular capture frame
blue_object still moving at last frame (no stop in clip)

no_events: no release, bounce, impact or contact; no direction change
